name: India Glycols Limited
remarksWeb: 4. Pursuant to the approval of the Board of Directors at its meeting held on 30th May, 2025 and subsequently by the shareholders of the Company on 22nd July, 2025, the Company has undertaken a sub-division/split of its equity shares, whereby 1 (One) equity share of face value Rs.10/- (Rupees Ten only) each has been sub-division/ split into 2 (Two) equity shares of face value Rs. 5/- (Rupees Five only) each, with effect from 12th August, 2025 and in this regard the Company has executed the Corporate Action on 13th and 14th August, 2025. Accordingly the number of equity shares has been increased from 3,09,61,500 equity shares having a face value of Rs. 10/- each to 6,19,23,000 equity shares having a face value of Rs. 5/- each. 5. Pursuant to the approval of the Board of Directors accorded at their meeting held on 16th October, 2025 and subsequently by the Shareholders of the Company on 12th November, 2025, the Company had allotted 51,03,765 equity shares on preferential basis having a face value of Rs. 5/- each on 24th November 24, 2025 to both Promoter and Non-Promoter categories. Out of which, 21,85,790 Equity Shares were allotted to the Promoter category and 29,17,975 equity shares were allotted under the Non-Promoter category. The entire 51,03,765 equity shares were credited to the Temporary ISIN: IN8560A01022 in pursuance to applicable provisions as on 31st December, 2025. However, the Listing & Trading approval for these shares were received from NSE and BSE on 5th January, 2026 effective 6th January, 2026. Accordingly, for the Shareholding pattern for the quarter ended on 31st December, 2025, we have clubbed the shares in main ISIN i.e. INE560A01023 and Temporary ISIN i.e. IN8560A01022 to reflect the actual paid-up share capital and shares under lock-in as on 31st December, 2025 for the relevant fields of the promoter and Non-Promoter category (public shareholding). 6. As the equity shares allotted to the promoters pursuant to the preferential issue were not admitted for listing and trading as of 31st December, 2025 and kept under a separate ISIN, which has been clubbed for the purpose of this shareholding pattern, the promoter shareholding is appearing less than 100% in dematerialised form. However, the entire allotment under the preferential issue was made in dematerialised form in compliance with Regulation 170(4) of the SEBI ICDR Regulations, 2018. Subsequently to quarter ended 31st December, 2025, Both NSE and BSE vide their letter dated 5th January, 2026 granted Listing and Trading Approval effective 6th January, 2026 for these shares.
